items.risk: Bookings were lower than expected, so agreement counts may not translate into durable revenue growth or attractive unit economics.
Enterprise AI remains highly competitive and substitution resilience is not established by these disclosures.
Large operating losses and cash burn make successful restructuring and renewed bookings growth central to execution quality.
Quarter-over-quarter bookings recovery is a positive turnaround signal, but one quarter does not establish durable bookings-to-revenue conversion or renewed growth.

Stock-based compensation remains large relative to quarterly revenue and the weighted-average share count increased materially year over year, so operating improvement may not translate proportionally into per-share value.

Restructuring benefits remain partly execution-dependent because vendor rationalization was still in progress at quarter end; failure to sustain sales productivity or cost discipline would weaken the turnaround case.
